card.line: Babel was a city in the land of Shinar where the LORD confused the language of the whole world and scattered people across the earth.

moments.title: Nimrod's kingdom begins
moments.text: Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD, had a kingdom that began in Babylon and other cities in the land of Shinar.

moments.title: The LORD scatters the people
moments.text: The LORD scattered the people over all the earth, and they stopped building the city. He confused the language of the whole world there, which is why it is called Babel.
